title.ko: 범죄 이야기: 과거 수동태 · 과거 진행 · 동사 변화
title.en: talking about crime: past passive, past continuous and verb forms

explain.ko: 사건을 이야기할 때는 과거형(The police arrested the suspect), 과거 진행형(I was reading when somebody took my bag), 과거 수동태(My bag was stolen)를 함께 씁니다. 누가 했는지 모르거나 중요하지 않으면 수동태를 쓰고, 도둑은 by somebody로 밝히지 않습니다. 사건 설명은 시간(at about ten o'clock), 장소(on the subway), 사람의 특징(tall, wearing a black coat) 순으로 말하면 전달하기 쉽습니다.
explain.en: To tell a story about a crime combine the past simple (The police arrested the suspect), the past continuous (I was reading when somebody took my bag) and the past passive (My bag was stolen). Use the passive when you don't know or don't care who did it. When you describe an event it helps to give the time (at about ten o'clock), the place (on the subway) and the person's appearance (tall, wearing a black coat).
